programme.title: Ava
programme.desc: Ava, 13 ans, apprend qu'elle perdra la vue plus tôt que ce qu'elle espérait, et affronte le problème à sa manière.

programme.title: Ice
programme.desc: la Russie contemporaine. Nadya abandonne son rêve lorsqu'elle est hospitalisée pour une blessure.

programme.title: Walt Avant Mickey
programme.desc: Walt Disney surmonte les obstacles de son enfance, créant Mickey Mouse et un empire légendaire.

programme.title: Opération Lidice
programme.desc: Le 27 mai 1942, à Prague, l'officier SS Reinhard Heydrich est victime d'un attentat organisé par la résistance

programme.title: Par Amour
programme.desc: Dans un cours de théâtre, l'amour sera vécu aussi fort que l'histoire de la pièce de Shakespeare.

programme.title: Un Noël à New York
programme.desc: Depuis un chagrin d'amour, Marie a perdu l'esprit de Noël. Une mystérieuse boîte de décorations semble pourtant ramener la magie dans sa vie… jusqu'au retour inattendu de son ex.

programme.title: Noël tous les jours
programme.desc: Sophie, productrice de télé-réalité accro au travail, tourne une émission sur Will, un homme qui célèbre Noël toute l'année. À ses côtés, elle redécouvre peu à peu la magie des fêtes.

programme.title: Pas de plan pour Noël
programme.desc: "Si l'organisatrice d'événements Celeste Everett veut sauver son entreprise et offrir à sa nièce un joyeux Noël, elle a besoin d'aide. Mais lorsque la nounou qu'elle engage s'avère être un homme, Celeste réalise avec surprise qu'elle a peut-être aussi trouvé l'amour de Noël pour elle-même."

programme.title: Le Chalet de Noël
programme.desc: Une divorcée, amoureuse de Noël, réserve un séjour en chalet avec sa mère et sa fille. Or, ce même chalet est réservé par une écrivaine célibataire qui déteste Noël. Ensemble, elles découvrent la magie de Noël et les liens familiaux.

programme.title: L'amour en trois rendez-vous
programme.desc: Kathy, animatrice radio populaire, rencontre John, créateur d'une application de rencontre, lors d'une émission en direct. Malgré leurs différences, l'alchimie entre eux est immédiate.

programme.title: Tootsie
programme.desc: Michael est un comédien talentueux mais sans travail. Quand sa petite amie, Sandy, rate une audition pour un feuilleton télé, il se travestit en femme et obtient le rôle sous le nom de Dorothy Michaels. Il devient rapidement le confident de Julie, l'actrice avec qui il partage la vedette. Mais il en tombe bientôt amoureux et malheureusement, le père de Julie tombe aussi amoureux... de Dorothy.

programme.title: Little Man
programme.desc: Un jeune homme pressé d'être père confond un jeune garçon qu'il doit adopter avec un criminel en fuite qui a la particularité d'avoir un visage poupin et d'être de petite taille. Mais ce dernier se rend vite compte qu'il vaut mieux avoir les flics aux fesses plutôt que des couches !

programme.title: Easy Girl
programme.desc: Après avoir menti en prétendant avoir perdu sa virginité, une jeune lycéenne très soignée fait l'objet d'accusations comparables à celles portées à Hester Prynne dans The Scarlet Letter, roman qu'elle est en train d'étudier à l'école. Elle décide de se servir de cette rumeur pour améliorer sa situation sociale et financière.

programme.title: Here Today (2021)
programme.desc: Charlie Burnz (Billy Crystal), un écrivain connu pour ses comédies hilarantes, se lie d'amitié avec une chanteuse de rue new-yorkaise Emma Payge (Tiffany Haddish). Emma gagne de manière inattendue un déjeuner avec la légende de la comédie et leur amitié prend un départ extrêmement difficile (pensez à une allergie aux fruits de mer, à une visite à l'hôpital et à un auto-injecteur d'épinéphrine). Il s'est passé beaucoup de choses avant que chacun trouve dans l'autre une sorte d'âme sœur, forgeant un lien profond qui met de côté le fossé générationnel et redéfinit le sens de l'amitié, de l'amour et de la confiance.

programme.title: Aloha
programme.desc: Un entrepreneur militaire reconnu revient sur le site de ses plus grands triomphes de carrière et renoue avec un amour de son passé, tout en craquant de manière inattendue pour une dure à cuire de l'Air Force qui lui est assignée.

programme.title: L'Arnaqueuse
programme.desc: Peg Dahl est une jeune femme qui espère quitter sa ville natale de Buffalo. Elle se lance dans le business du recouvrement de dettes. La guerre est déclarée avec le Roi des chasseurs de dettes de Buffalo.

programme.title: Le Chevalier black
programme.desc: Jamal Walker est un employé de Medieval World, un parc à thème vétuste. Il se retrouve soudain projeté dans le passé, au cœur de l'Angleterre du XIVe siècle.

programme.title: Une famille sur le ring
programme.desc: L'ancien catcheur Ricky et sa femme Julia vivent de leurs représentations avec leurs enfants, Saraya et Zak. Lorsque le frère et la sœur ont l'opportunité de passer des auditions pour la WWE, ils apprennent que devenir une Superstar WWE est bien plus exigeant qu'ils ne l'auraient imaginé.

programme.title: La vallée de la vengeance
programme.desc: Les fils d'un baron du bétail du Colorado, l'un biologique et l'autre adoptif, se détestent et se battent pour le contrôle de l'empire bovin de leur père.

programme.title: L'indien blanc
programme.desc: Pale Arrow est un homme blanc élevé depuis son enfance par le chef Pawnee.

programme.title: Jack l'Éclair
programme.desc: Lightning Jack Kane est un hors-la-loi australien dans l'Ouest sauvage.

programme.title: 2 frères appelés Trinita
programme.desc: Après avoir hérité d'un terrain dans un endroit poussiéreux appelé Trinity, les demi-frères antagonistes, Lester et Jesse, se réunissent pour poursuivre des aspirations différentes

programme.title: Scalps
programme.desc: Le commandant d'un fort texan pendant la guerre civile refuse de se rendre aux Nordistes et tente d'acheter la fille du chef de la tribu indienne locale.

programme.title: Randy le Solitaire
programme.desc: Emprisonné pour des meurtres qu'il n'a pas commis, Randy s'évade et tombe sur le repaire des vrais meurtriers.

programme.title: Les amours de Salomé
programme.desc: Une célèbre ballerine viennoise fuit l'Europe pendant la guerre austro-prussienne et tombe amoureuse d'un bandit américain qui ressemble à son défunt amant royal.

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: Un capitaine de cavalerie a beaucoup de mal à maintenir la paix entre son colonel tyrannique et un chef indien déterminé à se venger.

programme.title: Catherine de Russie
programme.desc: Caterina découvre que son mari, Pierre Tzar de Russie, complote pour la tuer. Elle libère le comte Orlov, ennemi juré de Pierre, devient impératrice de Russie et mène l'armée des Cosaques contre lui.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Une femme meurt. Son mari est en prison et le shérif a besoin de quelqu'un pour s'occuper du garçon jusqu'à ce que son oncle vienne le chercher. Les Cartwright commencent à s'occuper de l'enfant au Ponderosa.

programme.title: Last survivors
programme.desc: Au lendemain d'un événement apocalyptique qui a contraint les gens à un isolement extrême. Un père et son fils rencontrent une étrangère qui menace de détruire l'utopie qu'ils ont construite.

programme.title: Sputnik
programme.desc: Suite à un mystérieux incident dans l'espace, Constantin est amené dans un centre militaire confidentiel. Mais Constantin n'est pas revenu seul, quelque chose sommeille en lui ...

programme.title: Independence Daysaster
programme.desc: C'est le 4 juillet, et l'Amérique est en fête. Mais lorsqu'une force hostile attaque à la fois depuis l'espace et depuis l'intérieur même de la Terre, notre planète risque de finir sur le menu d'un barbecue festif.

programme.title: Alpha Rift
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un casque magique emmène Nolan Parthmore dans un monde de chevaliers modernes combattant le mal surnaturel, il est obligé de devenir le héros qu'il était destiné à être.

programme.title: Le dernier refuge: Au revoir monde
programme.desc: Alors qu'une attaque cyberterroriste plonge le monde dans le chaos, un groupe d'amis trouve refuge dans une maison de campagne. Confrontés à un avenir incertain, des tensions font surface.

programme.title: Invasion Planète Terre
programme.desc: Rho'ha est jugé pour meurtre par un tribunal humain, avec Joshua Doors chargé de l'accusation.

programme.title: The Outpost: Leur sang est noir
programme.desc: Talon et Luna tentent de libérer Zed, tandis que Garret pousse Tobin à trahir Falista et que Janzo explore l'Outpost.

programme.title: Invasion Planète Terre
programme.desc: La Résistance libère un virus créé par Augur au siège des Taelons à Washington, et la situation dégénère.

programme.title: Le Sorcier et le Serpent Blanc
programme.desc: Un maître moine tente de protéger un jeune médecin naïf d'un démon serpent vieux de mille ans. Un affrontement de pouvoirs psychiques s'ensuit, plongeant tout dans le chaos.

programme.title: Présentation du film La Crypte du Dragon
programme.desc: Présentation du film La Crypte du Dragon

programme.title: La Crypte du Dragon
programme.desc: Un groupe de chercheurs réveille une créature mythologique dans une crypte.

programme.title: Oro: La Cité Perdue
programme.desc: 1538, au cœur de l'Amazonie sauvage, un groupe de conquistadors espagnols part à la recherche d'une mythique cité d'or : Teziutlan. Aveuglés par leur quête et leur soif de richesse, ils plongent au plus profond de l'enfer vert, jusqu'à en perdre la raison.

programme.title: Robin des Bois : La Rébellion
programme.desc: Le Shérif de Nottingham et son cousin Guy de Gisbourne ont à charge de faire respecter la loi et de renforcer l'autorité.

programme.title: Grizzly
programme.desc: Lorsque le minivan transportant deux couples tombe en panne, leur présence attire un ours agressif.

programme.title: Mutant Tiger Chronicles
programme.desc: Chine, 560 après J.-C. Un étrange virus infecte des tigres assoiffés de sang.

programme.title: Year 10
programme.desc: Dans un monde dévasté, Jake affronte la barbarie pour sauver celle qu'il aime.

programme.title: Snake Outta Compton
programme.desc: Un groupe de rap affronte un serpent géant génétiquement modifié.

programme.title: Dinosaur World
programme.desc: Un jeu fait s'affronter des humains et des dinosaures.

programme.title: The Education of Charlie Banks
programme.desc: Charlie Banks affronte son ancien tyran du lycée lorsque celui-ci revient sur son campus.

programme.title: Le Testament caché
programme.desc: Une femme tient un journal de son long séjour dans un hôpital psychiatrique.

programme.title: L'Oracle
programme.desc: Un apprenti chirurgien se déguise en Juif pour étudier dans une école qui n'admet pas de chrétiens.

programme.title: Bachelor night
programme.desc: À Vegas, un EVJF et un EVG virent au chaos et seuls les témoins peuvent sauver leurs amis.

programme.title: Goldstone
programme.desc: Le détective indigène Jay Swan arrive dans la ville de Goldstone pour rechercher une personne disparue, et son simple devoir se complique lorsqu'il découvre un réseau de crime et de corruption.

programme.title: L'enfant loup
programme.desc: En 1954 à Cordoba, au cœur des montagnes de la Sierra Morena, le jeune Marcos qui fût vendu par son père à un berger, va lors du décès de ce dernier, se retrouver complètement seul et isolé du monde, et vivre au milieu des loups pendant plus de 12 ans!

programme.title: Lakeboat
programme.desc: Adaptation cinématographique de la comédie éponyme de David Mamet, "Lakeboat" traite d'un étudiant diplômé qui prend un job d'été sur un cargo des Grands Lacs et observe la vie à travers les yeux de ses membres d'équipage, simples d'esprit.

programme.title: Born to be blue
programme.desc: Afin de lui rendre hommage, un producteur de Hollywood propose à Chet Baker, le légendaire trompettiste de jazz des années 1960, de tenir le premier rôle dans un long métrage consacré à sa vie. Pendant le tournage, Chet tombe éperdument amoureux de Jane, sa partenaire afro-américaine.

programme.title: Shark Terror
programme.desc: Naufragée après une croisière, une jeune femme blessée est traquée par des requins

programme.title: Harry Brown
programme.desc: Un ancien militaire âgé cherche à venger le meurtre de son meilleur ami en faisant justice lui-même.

programme.title: Gassed Up
programme.desc: Pour sauver sa famille, Ash plongé dans le crime croise un Albanais charismatique.

programme.title: Rage of Stars
programme.desc: Une policière hantée par des visions mène une enquête pour sauver des enfants disparus.

programme.title: Beyond The Law
programme.desc: Un ancien détective apprend le meurtre de son fils dont il s'est éloigné. Cela va le conduire à s'aventurer de nouveau dans les rues sombres qu'il connait si bien. Armé, dangereux et n'ayant rien à perdre, il doit affronter la mafia locale pour se venger.

programme.title: The Renegade
programme.desc: Irlande, 1847. De retour de l'armée britannique, Feeney retrouve son pays ravagé par la famine.

programme.title: Worldbreaker
programme.desc: À l'aube de la fin du monde, un père cache sa fille, Willa, sur une île pour la protéger, tout en la préparant à survivre…

programme.title: Stalingrad (2013)
programme.desc: Dans une ville dévastée par l'armée allemande, des soldats russes déterminés se battent pour maintenir leur position dans un immeuble stratégique et se lient d'amitié avec une compatriote.

programme.title: Pensacola Wings of God
programme.desc: À Key West, un bateau de réfugiés cubains est attaqué tandis qu'un pilote cubain s'approche dangereusement des exercices.

programme.title: Pensacola Wings of God
programme.desc: Burner tombe amoureux d'une femme secrète, tandis que les Nuggets sont évalués lors d'un parcours se terminant par un bombardement.

programme.title: Phoenix Forgotten
programme.desc: En 1997, trois adolescents disparaissent dans le désert après avoir filmé les lumières mystérieuses apparues au-dessus de Phoenix.

programme.title: L'Équipée du Cannonball
programme.desc: Dans la course du Cannonball, des concurrents traversent les États-Unis à toute vitesse, prêts à tout pour arriver les premiers.

programme.title: Pensacola Wings of God
programme.desc: Les Anges bleus reviennent à Pensacola et offrent à Hammer une chance unique, tandis que Kate tombe amoureuse.

programme.title: Pensacola Wings of God
programme.desc: La mère d'Ice arrive sans prévenir, tandis qu'un crash provoqué lors d'un exercice place Spoon au cœur d'une enquête.

programme.title: Contre Enquête
programme.desc: Après le suicide suspect d'un soldat revenu d'Afghanistan, une journaliste refuse la version officielle et enquête sur une vérité plus sombre.

programme.title: Vampires en Toute Intimité
programme.desc: En Nouvelle-Zélande, une équipe s'installe dans la demeure de vampires afin de tourner un documentaire sur leur mode de vie. Les créatures tentent de sortir dans les bars, pensent nettoyer le sang après leurs méfaits, cherchent un style vestimentaire et découvrent Google. Elles doivent également faire face à un nouveau venu de leur espèce, très peu discret.

programme.title: Tucker & Dale Fightent le Mal
programme.desc: Tucker et Dale sont deux bouseux au grand cœur partis se ressourcer en pleine forêt. Mais leur route croise celle de jeunes étudiants fêtards qui, à la suite d'un quiproquo entraînant la mort de l'un d'entre eux, prennent Tucker et Dale pour des tueurs psychopathes et décident de leur faire la peau...

programme.title: You Might Be the Killer
programme.desc: Un animateur de colonie de vacances souffrant de trous de mémoire se retrouve entouré de victimes de meurtre. Il se tourne vers son amie passionnée de films d'horreur pour lui demander conseil et faire face au fait qu'il est peut-être le tueur.

programme.title: Rampant
programme.desc: Le Prince Ganglim, l'un des fils du roi au pouvoir, revient au royaume coréen de Joseon après de nombreuses années passées en captivité dans les geôles des Mandchous de la dynastie Qing. Des luttes pour obtenir le trône apparaissent bientôt au sein du palais royal alors qu'une épidémie transforme les humains en morts-vivants errants à la nuit tombée...

programme.title: The Communion Girl
programme.desc: En 1987, Sara et son amie trouvent une poupée de communiante qui déclenche une série d'horreurs.

programme.title: Contracted Phase II
programme.desc: Infecté par un virus, un homme lutte pour empêcher l'épidémie de se propager.

programme.title: Fire Island, la grande éruption
programme.desc: À Hawaï, un supervolcan entre en éruption, forçant une équipe à secourir les habitants menacés.

programme.title: Cosmoball
programme.desc: Un immense vaisseau accueille une compétition de sport spatial appelé Cosmoball.

programme.title: Le Maitre Chinois
programme.desc: Le jeune Wong Fei-Hong, enfant indiscipliné, est envoyé apprendre le Kung Fu chez son oncle au caractère très autoritaire. Seule une terrible menace pesant sur son père l'amène à rentrer chez lui.

programme.title: A L'aube Du 6eme Jour
programme.desc: Quand Adam Gibson, un homme de famille strict et pilote de combat décoré, découvre une nuit que sa vie a été volée par son clone, son existence parfaite est effacée. Plongé dans un monde sinistre de meurtre, de corruption et de tromperie high-tech, il est arraché à sa famille par des malfrats qui ont été envoyés pour le détruire. Adam doit non seulement sauver sa vie mais également découvrir qui est derrière ce complot diabolique afin de retrouver sa famille et son identité.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: Né dans les flammes de l'enfer, le démon Hellboy est transporté sur Terre lors d'une sombre cérémonie célébrée par les nazis, désireux d'utiliser les forces infernales à des fins de conquête. Sauvé par le docteur Broom, Hellboy est alors élevé pour combattre les forces du Mal.

programme.title: Mutant Ghost Wargirl
programme.desc: Dans le futur, une organisation secrète organise des compétitions clandestines pour très riches.

programme.title: Sniper: Le corbeau blanc

Their young kids are all there too, and they might stumble upon secrets that were being kept from them. programme.title: Gary and Emma Neville: Early Menopause Changed Us Forever

programme.title: David Tennant On The Struggles Throughout His Acting Career
programme.desc: David Tennant discusses the anxieties and stage fright he experiences as an actor, even with critical acclaim, and how a little fear can be useful to prevent complacency. He and Fearne explore how to work through moments when anxiety threatens to overwhelm you, and how concrete experiences over time provide a coping mechanism. David also shares his thoughts on whether celebrities should use their platform for social activism, and verifies some stories from online about his life.

programme.title: Dave Grohl On Overcoming Fear And Pursuing Your Dream

He talks with Fearne Cotton about the law of attraction, pursuing your dreams, and the importance of embracing mistakes and the unknown. Grohl reflects on his journey from hitting the road with Scream at 18 to his time in Nirvana and Foo Fighters, and how storytelling shaped his life from childhood in Springfield, Virginia.

He discusses getting into his daughter's favourite holiday hobby: rollercoasters.

The group tests Buzzballz, dark fruit cider, gin and tonic, rum and white wine, and bitter beer.

programme.title: Chris Hemsworth, Halle Berry & Mark Ruffalo Take On The British Test
programme.desc: Chris Hemsworth, Halle Berry and Mark Ruffalo take on the British Test. From making the perfect cup of tea to trying classic British snacks like sausage rolls, the results are hilarious. They see if they know which way the British public voted from Marvel vs DC to who they'd prefer to do a heist with. They put their British knowledge and taste buds to the test.

programme.title: Catherine Connolly On Palestine And A United Ireland
programme.desc: We speak with Irish presidential candidate Catherine Connolly. We look at the shape of Ireland, the involvement of younger people in politics, the Occupied Territories Bill, Irish neutrality and the triple lock. Catherine also speaks about the importance of the Irish language and why it's important to have women in politics and in the public eye.

programme.title: Brian Kerr On Beating Portugal And Ireland's Underage Triumphs
programme.desc: Brian Kerr reflects on his biggest successes with St Patrick's Athletic in the League of Ireland, his time in charge of Ireland's underage teams and beating Portugal and Netherlands as Ireland senior football manager.

programme.title: Brian Cox's Guide To Being A True Scot
programme.desc: Brian Cox sets the record straight on what it really means to be Scottish. From authentic Scottish slang to the biggest misconceptions people, especially in America, still get wrong. With sharp wit and no-nonsense honesty, he dives into real Scottish slang and what it actually means, the stereotypes that need binning immediately, the cultural differences that confuse the rest of the world, and a cheeky look at some of America's more baffling takes on Scotland.

programme.title: Big Tech Is Destroying Democracy
programme.desc: Baroness Beeban Kidron, filmmaker and tech campaigner, discusses her book Users: How Big Tech Took Control and How to Fight Back. She breaks down how big tech companies have influenced democracy, warped regulatory structures for their own benefit, and knowingly harmed their users.

programme.title: When Did Elon Musk Lose His Mind?
programme.desc: When did Elon Musk make the jump from salesman to supervillain? Quinn Slobodian and Ben Tarnoff trace Musk's journey from tech billionaire to stalwart of the online right. From his upbringing in apartheid South Africa to the rise of Tesla and SpaceX, they detail his changing views on AI and the "woke mind virus", as well as his eventual alliance with Donald Trump. Slobodian and Tarnoff examine his industrial philosophy, what led him to the White House, his purchase of Twitter, and his various attempts to further fuse technology into our lives.

programme.title: We Quiz FLO On Their Own Songs
programme.desc: FLO go head-to-head in the ultimate JOE Pub Quiz. The girls put their music knowledge to the test in a rapid-fire battle featuring rounds including Guess the Legendary Song from the First 5 Seconds, Do They Know Their Own Song Lyrics and a test of their general music knowledge. Along the way, FLO take on Zara Larsson's iconic Lush Life dance, chat Ariana Grande, Rihanna and more, and things get seriously competitive as they battle it out to become the one and only JOE Pub Quiz champion.

programme.title: Tom Holland vs Zendaya vs Jacob
programme.desc: Tom Holland, Zendaya and Jacob Batalon go head-to-head in the ultimate Spider-Man pub quiz. These legends put their memories to the test in a rapid-fire quiz covering their Spider-Man films. Do they know their lines, know about the franchise and even know random stills from the films? With bragging rights on the line and the title of pub quiz champion up for grabs, things quickly descend into chaos, confusion and comedy.

programme.title: Old People Try Bizarre Food
programme.desc: The Old People are back, this time taking on some of the internet's most bizarre celebrity food combinations. From viral TikTok trends to A-list guilty pleasures, they try and rate Dua Lipa's Pickle Diet Coke, Channing Tatum's Peanut Butter, Jelly & Cheetos Sandwich, and Beyoncé's Banana with Ketchup. Will these celebrity creations be surprisingly delicious or completely disgusting. Our Old People give their brutally honest verdicts.

programme.title: Keir Starmer's Weirdest Moments As Prime Minister
programme.desc: Keir Starmer's time in office has come to a close. His legacy includes some strange moments. From meeps to releasing sausages to going footy mad, relive all of the best and worst moments from the last two years. Hear clashes with Rishi Sunak and Kemi Badenoch, awkward encounters with Donald Trump, and gaffes at various major summits.

programme.title: AI CEOs Being Absolutely Insane
programme.desc: Have you ever paid attention to the voices behind the 'inevitable' AI revolution? OpenAI's Sam Altman, SpaceX's Elon Musk, and Palantir's Alex Karp are among the tech elite. They're building the models they claim will change work, politics, and life forever. But when they talk about this future, their rhetoric ranges from bizarre to sinister. From Musk's prediction that there's "a 10 to 20% chance of killer robots wiping out humanity" to Altman's sale of intelligence as utility, things look pretty bleak.

programme.title: Donald Trump's Most Embarrassing Moments
programme.desc: Donald Trump has a lot to say about the world. That doesn't mean he knows what he's talking about. From China to Venezuela and Canada to the UK, watch Trump's questionable comments about all corners of the globe.

programme.title: Gary Stevenson Interview
programme.desc: Gary Stevenson, economist and ex-Citibank trader, returns to PoliticsJOE just days after Andy Burnham became Prime Minister. Stevenson explains why he expects Labour to dodge serious taxation of the ultra-wealthy, instead quietly shifting the burden onto the upper middle class through moves like equalising capital gains and income tax. He breaks down why cutting VAT on energy bills is a quick political win rather than a real fix, and why he believes every government that fails to tax extreme wealth eventually gets forced into austerity, creating fertile ground for Reform and Farage.

programme.title: Generational
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Generational, a series bringing together football fans from every generation to debate the biggest talking points in the game. Topics include whether the Premier League has ruined football, if players from the 60s and 70s could cope in today's game, whether Jack Grealish is better than Pelé, if the FA Cup is still a major trophy, and whether Manchester City should be stripped of their trophies if found guilty. Different generations bring different perspectives, experiences and opinions, with plenty of disagreement and passionate arguments throughout.

programme.title: On The Ground at CPAC GB
programme.desc: Why are transatlantic forces of the right assembling in North Greenwich? Andy Twelves investigates CPAC GB, the new offshoot of America's longstanding Conservative Political Action Conference that hopes to unite the right in the UK. Attendees range from Tories like Liz Truss and Jacob Rees-Mogg to online voices like Young Bob and nationalist influencer Angloid to Americans who have made the trip across the pond. Nigel Farage attended the second day of the conference, and other speakers included Matt Goodwin and Matt Schlapp, CPAC's chair. Watch various factions of the right, from Conservatives to the Reform and Restore curious, fight for their ideas in speaking halls and a dimly lit expo centre.

programme.title: A King and His Queen
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: Liam's dad, a farmer, has ploughed up an old skeleton of a wolfblood in mid-transformation – and Liam is boasting about his ancestor being a werewolf hunter. Our Wolfbloods go to investigate. Jana is livid, telling tells the others they have a duty to give it the traditional wolfblood burial.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: It's a lunar eclipse, and Jana is bursting with excitement! This is the ultimate night for Wolfbloods, one where their wolf and their human are finally at one. They become a wolf on the inside, whist remaining - for an hour - human on the outside, apart from veining and yellow eyes. It's a buzz! Jana invites Rhydian to spend the eclipse with her on the moors, but Rhydian isn't sure.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: Jana, on her way to school, is surprised by Alric. Far from being terrified she flings herself into his arms. Jana hadn't been banished from the pack at all. Alric had sent her in to lure Rhydian into coming back with her. She has taken too long. He wants all three of them to return by the end of the day. In school, Tom is humiliated by Jimi showing off his judo in the gym.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: Maddy is in a mood now that Rhydian has moved out. Her parents are taking her, Shannon and Tom for a day in Blackpool to cheer her up. They stop at small garage called The Mottled Poppy to fill up and get directions. A white poppy on the counter changes colour when Daniel stands next to it and the owner, Bob Driscoll, seemingly friendly, excuses himself and leaves to make a sneaky phone call.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: It's election time for student rep on the school council! Jeffries doesn't expect anyone to be interested but Jana, now determined to be pack leader, throws up her hand. Maddy does too in retaliation. The Ks don't want either girl being their rep so Kara puts herself forward. Jimi can't bear the thought of all this girl power and volunteers himself as candidate.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: Rhydian, Shannon and Maddy catch Jana breaking into Shannon's locker before school. Jana defends herself she HAS to get Shannon's laptop to destroy the data. Maddy lands on Shannon's side but secretly, she and Rhydian know that Jana is right it's a ticking time bomb.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: As student rep, Kara is in charge of organising tonight's school disco which she and the other K's are determined to make the coolest night of the year. Katrina is also excited because she thinks Harry Averwood is to be her date that night. The problem for our Wolfbloods is that there's no moon and all they want to do is sleep.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: The class are Camping overnight in Aern Hollow before the orienteering task the next day. Liam has his ancestor's journal with him outlining how he found and tracked the werewolf he shot (ep 3). In their respective tents, Maddy, Jana and Rhydian use their wolfblood hearing to listen in, telling Tom and Shannon what they hear.

programme.title: Wolfblood
programme.desc: The day before school Parents' Evening, Maddy, Tom, Shannon and Rhydian are helping Jana clean her caravan. Rhydian's Mother, Ceri, shows up. But it's not just Rhydian she has come to see. She tells Jana that her Father Alric has been deposed by the pack, making Jana the new Alpha. If Jana doesn't assume her destiny as heir, the pack will destroy itself as betas fight for control.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Smash is looking forward to 4 paid hours in a recording studio. Anala, who has been a jumbo-size pain for a while, takes Alex's guitar and transports her, first with and then without Kuru, to places she believed to exist only in a childhood dream. There she learns the elephant always protected her.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Alex is too sad about Marcus having dumped her and effectively split up the band Smash to do her school - or domestic work. Even ever-respectful Kuru can't deny she lacks commitment, especially as the princess. She now declares herself ready to accept the throne.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Having learned Omar is her dad, Alex has ran back to the Wilsons. Kuru comes pack, take his leave from the Wilsons and offer generous gifts. They include a model and wood for a Manjipoorean gazebo, which dad Jim is unable to construct, but he gets JB to help and talks him into making up with Alex.

programme.title: The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Just when Vashan prepares for his coronation, he discovers Diva has magical powers, but too late: she throws him in the dungeon. When Omar and while he flees Kuru find out, she tries to kill them, but Anala saves them by transportation to the Wilson home. Alex uses magic to cure Omar's wound.

programme.title: Dr. Romantic Ep.7 (English Dub)
programme.desc: Details There's a standoff at the lobby of the Doldam Hospital. This time, it's In Bum and Hyeon Cheol versus Dr. Kim and the rest of the staff. The dispute isn't over after all the talks that had happened, and the future of Doldam seems to be entering murky waters of this devilish foggy forest of no hope. The micromanagement of President Do is getting in the way of Dr. Kim. For now, Seo Jung handles an 8 in a hundred chance of survival surgery.

programme.title: Dr. Romantic Ep.8 (English Dub)
programme.desc: A hostage-taking crisis happens in the operating room. The victim at the edge of the knife is Seo Jung, with the sole request is to stop the surgery that currently takes place. The medical team informs the police, but the armed suspect is ready to kill Seo Jung at any minute. With two people's lives on the line, Dr. Kim needs to think fast.

programme.title: Dr. Romantic Ep.9 (English Dub)
programme.desc: Dr. Kim comes back unexpectedly, as they all thought he was still under investigation. Everyone doesn't also expect Dr. Kim's new visitor, who happens to be Chairman Shin himself. After being mocked by Hyeon Cheol for being incompetent, Dr. Kim now operates on the big boss. After Dong Joo speaks up of the truth of the unjust treatment received by Doldam Hospital, the chairman makes an important phone call.

programme.title: Dr. Romantic Ep.10 (English Dub)
programme.desc: Dong Joo tells Seo Jung to never leave without telling him again. Their conversation is interrupted by the 6-car accident on the road ahead of them. At the hospital, Eun Tak punches an investigator that prompts the need for police intervention. The problem faced by Dr. Kim now is the fact that the whole place is a mess, and there's chaos coming for them.

programme.title: Dr. Romantic Ep.11 (English Dub)
programme.desc: Seo Jung is caught inside Dr. Kim's office, while President Do convinces Dong Joo to be part of his team. Yoon Wan wants to test the worth of Dong Joo, while Dr. Kim worries that Seo Jung isn't trustworthy enough just yet. Dong Joo now deals with a patient who is suspected of being abused. The drunk driver from the major accident shows up with his rich mother that ultimately bothers Seo Jung.

programme.title: Dr. Romantic Ep.12 (English Dub)
programme.desc: An advanced death certificate needs to be signed by Dong Joo. He refuses to do so, but President Do and Hyeon Cheol urge him to act quickly against his will. Dr. Kim comes into the office just in time to witness the act. A cardiac arrest happens in the emergency ward, which prompts Dong Joo and Seo Jung to team up against the call of death. Another day in Doldam is another day of broken and mended hearts.

programme.title: Dr. Romantic Ep.13 (English Dub)
programme.desc: In Bum reveals the condition of Chairman Shin to Dr. Kim. His heart condition doesn't seem great, and he wants to assist in the operation. What appears to be a mere urge to take action is unknowingly a plot assembled by the president to keep an eye on Dr. Kim during his alleged unethical practice. An eager Seo Jung catches up on her mentor and gathers information to solve the medical case.

programme.title: Do You Like Brahms? Ep.8
programme.desc: Song Ah becomes all too aware that people are saying Joon Young is on a different level than she is. She loses confidence and keeps trying to distance herself from Joon Young. Meanwhile, Joon Young reacts coldly when he finds Jung Kyung in front of his house. Afterward, Joon Young calls Song Ah, saying he has something to tell her.

programme.title: Do You Like Brahms? Ep.9
programme.desc: Song Ah and Joon Young finally realize they have mutual feelings for one another, and they have a few blissful moments together. Meanwhile, Hyeon Ho finds out about Joon Young and Song Ah's relationship and gets angry. The stress caused by his broken friendship and the seemingly perpetual cycle of preparing for competitions starts to wear on Joon Young.

programme.title: Do You Like Brahms? Ep.10
programme.desc: Seong Jae suggests that Joon Young talks about his family on TV for publicity. Joon Young feels both insulted and ashamed, but he holds his ground. Meanwhile, Song Ah asks Joon Young if she can visit his place. She keeps feeling Jun Kyung's presence around Joon Young both at his apartment and later on at school.

programme.title: Do You Like Brahms? Ep.11
programme.desc: Seong Jae finds out that Song Ah and Joon Young are dating and calls her for a chat. His bluntness hurts her feelings. Later on, Joon Young joins Song Ah on a sudden trip to Daejeon and shows her around the neighborhood where he grew up. After an unexpected meeting with his mother, Joon Young opens up to Song Ah about more personal matters.

programme.title: Do You Like Brahms? Ep.12
programme.desc: Song Ah has to look for a new accompanist when her last one quits. She asks her acquaintances for help, but she has no luck. Just then, Joon Young offers to play for her. People find out that Song Ah and Joon Young are dating and that Joon Young is playing for Song Ah's grad school exam. Rumors about them spread like wildfire, which makes Song Ah doubt if she made the right decision. Meanwhile, Joon Young looks for paid work performing at a concert.

programme.title: Do You Like Brahms? Ep.13
programme.desc: With Jung Kyung constantly asking Joon Young whether he still has feelings for her, Joon Young once again tells her how he feels. Later, Song Ah questions Joon Young about his whereabouts last night after seeing him and Jung Kyung ride off in a taxi. When Director Nah asks Joon Young a favor regarding Jung Kyung, he turns down her request. Meanwhile, Song Ah is going through a hard time herself and makes a decision that should've been made a long time ago.

programme.title: My Troublesome Star Ep.11
programme.desc: Actress Im Se Ra (Jang Da A) is on top of the world after becoming the youngest winner of a best actress award. Unfortunately, that same night, she's hit by a truck - and transported 25 years into the future, where she wakes up in the body of middle-aged woman Bong Cheong Ja (Uhm Jung Hwa). Cheong Ja decides to return to acting, hoping to restore her former glory and figure out what happened to her. She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

programme.desc: Mountains define some of our most spectacular landscapes, creating a mosaic of dramatic habitats, teaming with incredible wildlife. Mountains are found on every continent on Earth, covering 22% of the planet's surface. They're a vital part of our ecosystem a quarter of terrestrial animal and plant species live in mountains and they house an incredible 85% of all amphibians, mammals and birds. It's no wonder that so many cultures consider mountains sacred places: gateways to the heavens.

programme.title: Nature's Most Dangerous

And to fuel our fetish for fear, we turn to the animal kingdom. But what is the truth behind the killers of the natural world? Do they live up to their reputations, and who really is the most dangerous? From killer crocs to ferocious big cats, we'll run you through the most dangerous teeth, fangs, stingers and bites in the animal kingdom. These are the deadliest animals on planet earth.

programme.title: Antelope

Some are easy to miss, the little dik-dik being barely the size of a house cat, while eland weigh in at more than half a ton. There are representatives roaming plains from the Mongolian Plateau in Asia to the cape of South Africa. Wherever you find them, these remarkable animals are the unsung heroes of the plains.

programme.title: glCuba
programme.desc: Even anyone who has not yet been to Cuba can conjure up certain images of American vintage street cruisers, imposing buildings that have seen better days, white sandy beaches full of palms and loving couples on the Malecón against a backdrop of crashing waves. This island is somewhat of a myth and its people generate a special joie de vivre. The legendary Hershey Train departs for Matanzas from the capital, Havana. On the oldest electrified railway line in the Caribbean, 60-year-old Spanish carriages make their way along al-most 100 kilometres of coastline in the most relaxed way possible. The Salvavidas on Varadero, probably the most famous beach on the island, have a particular-ly beautiful workplace. The lifeguards' territory ex-tends for more than 20 kilometres. In order to protect the coasts of Cuba, mangroves have been replanted here for many years. The project is supported by the UN and planting is often carried out by schoolchildren. In doing so, Cuban children learn how to treat their maritime habitat in a sustainable fashion. The former colonial city of Trinidad on Cuba's south coast is gen-erally considered to be one of the most beautiful places in the entire Caribbean. The houses here are particular-ly colourful. A plethora of magnificent buildings can be seen at the Plaza Mayor, the neo-baroque main square.

programme.title: mareTV: The Eckernförde Bay
programme.sub-title: Beach shooters, mine clearance divers, squirrels
programme.desc: Fjord, ford, bay, gulf: there are many names for the beautiful extensions of the Baltic Sea into the country. Eckernförde Bay is shaped by currents, surf and people. It stretches 17 kilometers to the town that gives it its name. Stephan Möller is the acting shooting master of the Eckernförder Bürgerschützengilde. He spent a whole year preparing the beach shooting festival and then this: fog, rain and a stiff breeze. Traditionally, the Eckernförde marksmen always shoot at a wooden bird in the direction of the sea at Whitsun. Under strict conditions! And these stipulate a clear view of at least one kilometer out into the bay. The event literally threatens to fall through, for the first time in 449 years. Around 3,000 soldiers are stationed at the Eckernförde naval base, but only a small group is allowed to call itself an elite unit: the mine divers. They are considered the toughest soldiers in the Navy. Anyone who wants to be one of them has to undergo extreme training. This year, just two candidates made it to the final round. Now they still have to pass the dreaded final exam: running 20 kilometers with marching gear and then swimming ten kilometers through Eckernförde Bay.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks

Barren and rocky ridges in the plateaus, contrast with large forests and lush ground vegetation in deep valleys, crossed by lakes and rivers. The park is known for its oak forests, which are predominantly pedunculate and Pyrenean oaks. Among the typical animals of the park are the small Garrano ponies, a very old breed of horse and the only one in Europe that still lives in the wild.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: In this episode of the documentary series Andreas Kieling reports from the Amazon basin, Siberia, South Africa, the mountains of western China and the Eiffel region back home in Germany. Kieling ventures to western China almost as far as the border with Tibet in search of the great panda, the legendary bamboo bear. Set against a gigantic natural backdrop, the filmmaker is attempting to track down the extremely reclusive creature. But finding one of the approximately 3000 pandas who live in the vast mountainous landscape and capturing it on camera is like searching for a needle in a haystack. And then comes a stunning close encounter with the beautiful creatures at a very special place: the breeding station at Wulong. The precious bears live in huge natural enclosures here, breeding and providing specimens to be loaned to a number of zoos all over the world. These particular creatures are only able to serve as ambassadors for their few relatives who still live in the wild since they have become accustomed to captivity, they would not be able to survive by themselves in the rainforests.

programme.title: Wild Serbia
programme.desc: Serbia is in the heart of the Balkans, a “little Europe“ within Europe with its rich variety of landscapes and natural beauties, it certainly does this name justice. This nature documentary presents Serbia's breath-taking, picturesque regions and unique wildlife on a journey to the most beautiful and wildest areas of the Balkan peninsula, from high mountains across gentle hills to the vast plains of the Puszta. Serbia is only about five times the size of Schleswig Holstein, yet here the most varied vegetation zones, animal kingdoms and cultures meet. And even today a large number of Serbian people live in close communion with nature. They are proud of the storks' nests in the villages, the ancient species of livestock that have been preserved and the vultures that return to make their home here. In many places people are pleased to see bears, lynx and wolves, and even jackals are at home in the forests of Siberia. It is a country full of traditions and folklore, with deep influences from the Orient as well as the West. The Danube is the most prominent river in Serbia. As it makes its way through the Carpathian Mountains of Rumania it forms the most imposing gorge in Europe, the Iron Gates. Other striking features of Serbia's landscape include the archaic earth pyramids of Devil's Town, towering up in powerful red colours - and what must be the driest region of Siberia, the Deliblatska Pescara, which is also known as Europe's Sahara. Colourful birds called bee-eaters have settled on a rocky slope - a whole, noisy colony of them. They make their nests in caves which they dig themselves in the ground, and the inaccessible location means it is difficult for enemies to reach them. The more frequently the male brings the female insects it has caught, the more powerful is the bond between them later.

programme.title: Saturday Knight Fever
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters catching a cold means trouble for the NEXO-Knights when he can create an entirely new kind of “snotty” monster. King and Queen Halbert have journeyed to the town of Cleanington to open the brand new Scrubbery Barn at the invitation of Roger the Scrubber (seen in 104.) Meanwhile, the Book of Monsters drags Jestro to Snottingham – one of the coldest places in Knighton where everyone coughs, has a runny nose and is generally under-the-weather. The BOM demands that Jestro feed him a “snotheiser” ball which will probably make him sick. The BOM explains that if he is sick, he may just produce a whole new breed of magical monsters … some that the knights would NEVER expect. The BOM gets sick and starts coughing up phlegm globlins and bloblins. The Knights arrive, alerted to what they think is an attack on the town by Snottingham's mayor, Hack Coughmeier. The sickened, sneezy, snotty monsters infect the knights and, more importantly, the knights' NEXO-Shields. Now their NEXO-Powers are infected. As they try to download something to fight the monsters, they realize the powers they get are off strange, infected versions of their powers. The knights drive Jestro and his snot monsters off and they turn in for the night. And, overnight, they all get sick. Meanwhile, the BOM order a nice, hot lava bath…he'll feel fine by morning. But the knights wake-up with colds and they feel terrible. Ava and Merlok 2.0 thinks it will pass in a day or two…it's just a typical Snottingham cold. Each knight gets sick in their own funny way and their illnesses play right into Jestro and the BOM's hands: they're headed to Cleanington to kidnap the king! The citizens of the ultra-clean city hate the sight of monsters, but then feel caught in between when the sick, sneezy, snotty knights arrive on their Fortrex. The fight goes terribly for the knights. They try to download the Nexo-power “Glorious Griffon” but instead get just feathers. So they improvise and tickle the monsters! Ava finally comes up with a way to use some anti-virus tools on their NEXO-Shields and just as Jestro is about to take the king and queen away, the NEXO-Knights get their normal powers back! They defeat Jestro and save the king and queen.

programme.title: Open Mike Knight
programme.desc: The Book of Betrayal leads Jestro and his Monsters to Funnyton – the funnies town in the kingdom. When they Knights arrive to capture him, they discover (to their shock) that Jestro and the Book of Monsters are now the town's top comedians! Jestro and his monsters are in attack formation moving to pillage the town of Funnyton. But when they arrive, ready to tear into the place, they see that nobody's in town. Then, they hear…laughter?! The entire town is there listening to a stand-up comic JOKES KNIGHTLY. He's hilarious. He commands such power, such attention, and such loyalty. Jestro and the BOM decide they must become funny. They order all kinds of book on comedy from Spamazon: books on parody, irony, insult humor, slapstick, satire, knock-knock jokes, elephant jokes, “my monster is so fat” jokes, etc. They work-up a ventriloquist act with the BOM sitting on Jestro's lap. They start doing their act and, surprisingly, they're funny. They're very funny. The Fortrex arrives and the knights rush out, ready for battle. They fight through a string of monsters just outside the town, but discover they're only working as “bouncers” to keep too many people out of the comedy club. (“Sorry, you guys aren't on the list.”) The knights hear loud laughs and head there. In the club, they discover the town isn't being held hostage, they're in the show voluntarily having a great time. And…Jestro and the BOM are funny. Meanwhile, during the show, Jokes Knightly decides he'll steal the BOM and Jestro's act. During the intermission at the comedy show, Clay comes backstage to talk to Jestro. Maybe, Clay says, this shows that Jestro doesn't have to be bad…he is funny, like Clay always said he was. Meanwhile, Jokes Knightly steals the BOM and Jestro can't find it. He panics. Clay encourages him…go on stage alone, be funny…he can do it! Jestro goes out and is funny on his own he hits all his punchlines, he gets big laughs he starts to see that Clay is right. The BOM sees that Jokes Knightly has a “joke book” that turns out to be the BOOK OF BETRAYAL. That's how Mike Knight has become so funny – by stealing everyone's material! BOM calls in Magmar, who saves him from Mike Knight AND takes the Book of Betrayal. As Jestro comes off-stage to great applause, the BOM tells him they have the Book of Betrayal. The BOM calls in Magmar and his monsters and they start a fight as Clay comes to Jestro's defense and calls on the other Knights for backup. A big battle ensues that destroys the comedy club in Funnyton. The Knights win and drive-off Magmar, the monsters and the BOM. As they retreat, the BOM looks around: “Where's my Jestro?!” Jestro sneaked away during the fight and is in a nearby forest with…the Book of Betrayal.

programme.title: The Fortrex And The Furious
programme.desc: In a massive chase around Knighton, the NEXO-Knights attempt to keep the Book of Betrayal out of the Book of Monster's grip. But the evil book is persistent. Will he get the final piece of his evil puzzle? We finally REVEAL that Jestro has given the Book of Betrayal to…Clay. He tells Clay what it is and how Mike Knight used it. And it seems that the Book of Monsters believed it to be the final ingredient in some ‘Master Plan.” Suddenly, they realize Monsters – led by Magmar and the super-mad Book of Monster – are after them! Clay retreats with Jestro and the Book of Betrayal to rendezvous with the other Knights at the Fortrex. The Fortrex isn't fast enough they'll need their own vehicles. They decide that they need to split up and go in multiple directions to make the monsters expend their resources on a chase. It's a huge chase, being covered like a crazy news event by the Knighton News Network. We see a montage of the monsters stopping and capturing all the Knights vehicles: Aaron, Macy, Lance…finally Axl. However, as they do, they realize that the Knights have used Squirebots in Jestro Fan Jester hats (from the vendor at the comedy club in 108) as decoys. They think Axl has the Book of Betrayal in his BRICK containment unit, but it turns out to be the Ned Knightly Comic from episode 203. The Monsters finally corner Clay, who has the real Jestro and Book of Betrayal in his sword vehicle. Before Clay can protest, Jestro pushes the launch button and fires off Clay in the vehicle's rocket sword. The monsters race off with Jestro, leaving the shocked Clay fearing for his friend. Now, Magmar tells the Book of Monsters, they only need to get BOB. Clay makes his way back to the Fortrex and tells what has happened. They decide they must get to the Redoubt of Ruination in the Lava Lands and try to save Jestro. Meanwhile, we see, INTERCUT, a scene where Merlok 2.0 and the Book of Monsters explain the Books of Evil, how they were created and what the BOM will use them for. Merlok, back in the day, split the evil MONSTRUX into 10 magic books to keep him from ever being a threat. Only, he didn't destroy the books…and now the BOM has them and Monstrux can come back into the world! Meanwhile, the BOM has set up the huge, ceremonial arena at their HQ so they can have the ceremony to bring Monstrux back into the world. Jestro realizes he's been a pawn of the Book of Monsters. Jestro says he'll never get the Book of Betrayal…the Knights have it. In the last scene, we see Clay taking the Book of Betrayal from the Fortrex, climbing into his vehicle and driving towards…the Redoubt of Ruination! Has the Book of Betrayal worked its evil magic on him?!

programme.title: Kingdom Of Heroes
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters, having the final pieces of his evil plan in place, tries to take human form. Can the NEXO-Knights and Merlok 2.0 stop the greatest threat they've ever faced? Or will the kingdom be plunged into darkness…forever. The Redoubt of Ruination readies the final ceremony to call forth MONSTRUX, the arch-necromancer of the past. Clay, holding the Book of Betrayal walks to the gates of the spooky place. Inside, Clay hears strange…singing and music. It's like a twisted Broadway show of some kind. Meanwhile, the Knights all realize Clay is gone and so is the Book of Betrayal. Macy says Clay must be up to something. They have to trust him and, more importantly, they have to find him. At the Redoubt of Ruination the ceremony has already begun! The Book of Monsters wants the final ceremony that calls forth Monstrux to be like a really great show! The BOM then barfs up all the BOOKS OF EVIL into their places around Jestro. He's just missing the BOOK OF BETRAYAL, which Clay has. Clay says he'll trade the book for Jestro. The BOM immediately agrees to the deal and sets Jestro free. Then, Monsters grab-up Clay, restrain him, and put him in Jestro's place on the sacrifice stone. From outside, they're interrupted by the sounds of battle the Knights have arrived on the Fortrex and are attacking the Redoubt of Ruination. In the confusion, Jestro slips away. The BOM lets loose with a powerful protection spell to keep the Knights out as he starts with the ceremony…he's going to bring Monstrux out and remanifest him in Clay's body! Jestro is able to escape the Redoubt and make his way to the Knights, who can't seem to battle their way in. It's a race against time as the Knights try to get in and save Clay. As the Knights get in, they see that the crazy BOM is absorbing all the Books of Evil, one-by-one. He grows BIGGER and BIGGER! Macy calls for NEXO-Power…but it's not enough! The gigantic Book of Monsters sucks down the final book, the Book of Betrayal! He looms over Clay, about to consume him, too, and make him into Monstrux! Suddenly, Robin appears carrying TECHKALIBER…he tosses it to Clay. Just as the huge Book of Monsters falls on Clay, he holds up Techkaliber and Merlok 2.0 is there…his full power in the sword. Clay sticks the sword into the Book of Monster's huge mouth. BOOM! There's a BIG, MAGICAL EXPLOSION! As we cut back inside, we see the Book of Monsters is gone. The Knights release Clay and he thanks them and Jestro for saving him. Jestro thanks them all for saving him and seeing the good in him. WE DISSOLVE TO: The JoustDome. In a final ceremony the King and Queen reward the knights and congratulate them for keeping the kingdom safe. There are speeches, happiness and friendship. And Jestro even does a bit that's funny. At the very end we see a hint of something…Monstrux and the Book of Monsters are still out there.

The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: CRIME FILES
programme.desc: It All Begins Around Us This Crime Show Explores Crimes That Occur Within Our Own Communities And Among People We Know. It Tells The Compelling Stories Of Ordinary Lives Disrupted By Crime, With Relatable Characters Representing The World Around Us. The Show'S Mission Is To Raise Awareness About Crime Prevention While Keeping Viewers Engaged And Intrigued."

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.16
programme.desc: As Jeongi explains the shape of a wine cup, Gwanghae finds his gaze drawn to her lips and abruptly excuses himself, flustered by his own reaction. Later, Gangcheon is stunned to discover Euldam's pottery at the merchant guild and asks Hwa-ryeong whether Jeongi is truly Euldam's daughter. Taedo quietly observes Jeongi and Gwanghae sitting side by side before the kiln. On the day of the Giroyeon banquet, Jeongi grows increasingly anxious when the vessels fail to arrive at the hall.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.17
programme.desc: Upon discovering that Jeongi is Euldam's daughter, Gangcheon expels her from the Bunwon workshop. In front of everyone, Mun Saseung kneels and begs Gangcheon to spare her. When Hwa-ryeong declares that she will live solely to defeat Jeongi, Taedo is left shaken. Soon after, Jeongi is ordered to craft a porcelain vase as a birthday gift for Royal Consort Inbin, and Gwanghae promises to support her with everything he has.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.18
programme.desc: Startled by the sound of vases shattering inside the kiln, Jeongi peers inside and suddenly collapses. Hearing that Jeongi had been guarding the kiln alone, Gwanghae turns pale and desperately searches for her. Taedo watches over the unconscious Jeongi with quiet anguish. Seeing Jeongi injured, her eyesight damaged, Gwanghae is overcome with pain—yet Jeongi asks only to be allowed back into the Bunwon.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.19
programme.desc: Claiming she has no lingering attachment, Jeongi leaves the Bunwon behind, and Gwanghae watches her go in hollow disbelief. After returning to her former home, Jeongi and Taedo are suddenly seized by military officers, who drag Taedo away. Gwanghae pleads with Inbin to release him, insisting that Taedo once served as his personal guard. Awakened by her mother Yeonok's voice, Jeongi rises and walks toward the kiln…

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.20
programme.desc: King Seonjo orders Gwanghae, Imhae, and Shinseong to find a way to end the people's widespread stomach illness, prompting Gwanghae to disguise himself and investigate in secret. While surveying the village, he unexpectedly encounters Jeongi, who is making and distributing bowls to the villagers. Jeongi carefully presents a vessel she crafted especially for Gwanghae. Soon, a royal decree is issued for the Bunwon to produce pottery for the common people, and Gwanghae sets out to find Jeongi.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.21
programme.desc: Despite Taedo's warnings that it is dangerous, Jeongi insists she must remain at the Bunwon to bring Gangcheon down from his nangcheong post. Reunited with Jeongi at the workshop, Gwanghae cannot hide his quiet delight. Meanwhile, Yukdo grows uneasy when he is forced to compete with Jeongi to create the lid for King Seonjo's cherished jar. He promises Jeongi that if she succeeds, he will elevate her to the rank of master potter.

programme.title: I'm LIVE Ep.311
programme.desc: Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy this new extraordinary performance presented by An Ji-Yeong!Joining us on this week's episode of I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter BOL4! In this episode, BOL4 performs “FRIEND THE END, ”ROME,“ ”Red Lipstick,“ ”Stars over me,“ and more to show off her artistry. BOL4 is An Ji-Yeong's one-person band, known for its adorable sounds and lyrics depicting spring, stars, cherry blossoms, and the universe. In April, BOL4 released its new album, “LOVE.zip,” illustrating various forms of love through the language of music. Following the release, An also held a concert and impressed the audience with her unique, silky voice as well as her growth as a musician. BOL4 is making a comeback on I'm LIVE for the first time in 4 years, marking its third appearance, with the first one in 2017 and the second in 2019.

programme.title: I'm LIVE Ep.312
programme.desc: Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet 10CM!Joining us on this week's episode of I'm LIVE is 10CM! 10CM previously mentioned that he wanted to be just 10 cm away from the audience, not 1 meter, when he takes part in I'm LIVE again. Within a distance of 10 cm, he performs “My Ultimate First Love,” “Gradation,” “Phonecert,” “Drawer,” and more to warm our hearts. 10CM, a.k.a. the idol star of the Korean indie scene, is back on I'm LIVE“ with his new song ”My Ultimate First Love.“ As the title implies, this new song depicts a man's first love and childhood and apparently is the one-man band's first song about first love. Full of 10CM's trademark sentiments, it praises the purity of young love, and to commemorate the release, 10CM also organized a large-scale flash mob challenge together with about 1,000 musicians. 10CM has released numerous chart-topping hits since its debut in 2010. Also known for his fantastic live performances and stage manners, he's a truly sought-after musician both at home and abroad.

programme.title: I'm LIVE Ep.313
programme.desc: In this episode, MRCH performs “To the dawn,” “Still Romance,” “Love is a magic,” “MRCH mood,” and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!Joining us on this week's episode of I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter MRCH! MRCH made herself known to the public through a music show in 2018. After getting a music composition degree at Yonsei University, she released her debut mini-album, “Let's march!” and has built her career as not only a singer but also a composer and lyricist, co-composing “Talk that Talk,” the lead single of Twice's 11th mini-album. This musician is also active on YouTube her cover of Coldplay's “Viva La Vida” gained 6.5 million views and engraved her name in the minds of music fans around the world. Apparently, I'm LIVE is MRCH's first TV appearance, and she is bound to showcase all that she has in store.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.
